page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmg7.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture bare-metal instance powered by Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at 2.9 GHz. It features 128 dedicated physical cores with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, providing 128 vCPUs. The system is equipped with 512.0 GB of RAM, yielding 4.0 GB of memory per core.

This instance does not include bundled local storage, requiring external block storage solutions for data persistence. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers. The virtualization is managed via the KVM hypervisor.

Given its dedicated physical core allocation and high resource density, the instance offers high compute reliability without hyperthreading overhead. This makes it qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring predictable, non-shared CPU performance. Best-fit workloads include large-scale general-purpose applications, high-performance computing tasks, and enterprise databases requiring dedicated CPU execution.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmg7.32xlarge is a high-capacity bare-metal instance featuring 128 dedicated physical cores powered by Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at 2.9 GHz. The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of RAM, establishing a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage, relying instead on network-attached storage, but features a 64 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Virtualized via KVM, this instance is designed for demanding workloads that require dedicated CPU resources, such as enterprise databases, high-performance computing, and large-scale general-purpose applications.
